qualification.semanticRoleMapping: names-only; unapproved, do not assume final role mapping
qualification.figmaVariableModeStructure: one mode (Mode 1) per collection; dark and light are separate collections

notes: Hex channels are 8-bit rounded renderings of Figma RGB floats. Raw float precision is not archived in this snapshot. All local color variables have alpha=1.
Figma name Countainer preserved in figmaName; engineering tokenId mirrors the typo and can be normalized in a dedicated mapping later without altering source.
No aliases among local variables: do not infer a link between surface/semantic colors and primitive Color Palette simply because some hex values match.
Figma name Base Color Alpha/Black/White represents opaque colors in variables; alpha transparency may be applied in paints as a separate opacity, not asserted here.
Registry is a point-in-time reference catalog, not an approved palette or synchronization script.
